purpose.summary: A web-based COBOL CGI program that generates a report of neighborhoods (Bairros) sorted either alphabetically or numerically by municipality. It reads from two indexed files (PD14800 municipalities, PD14900 neighborhoods), sorts the data, and outputs an HTML report with a parameter-selection screen.
purpose.domain: government/municipal administration (Brazilian postal/address data, likely ECT-related)

verdict.notes: The file uses the Micro Focus htmlpp preprocessor to embed HTML directly in COBOL source, a pattern used for CGI-based web applications. The program appears to be part of a Brazilian municipal/postal address management system (ECT = Empresa Brasileira de Correios e Telégrafos). The $set sourceformat"free" directive explains the free-format layout despite the fixed-format mechanical guess. Source was truncated at 16000 chars but enough is visible to classify confidently.
